label: Lab · genus 3, type 0
title: Lab · 12 faces, genus 3 (type 0)
note: Why it matters: its map extends, by 3 explicit handles (certificate in the repo), to one of the 59 maps a 12-face Szilassi-type polyhedron must have; realizing those handles geometrically would solve the open problem. Planes and map in the source file.

label: Lab · genus 3, solid-first
title: Lab · 12 faces, genus 3 (solid-first)
note: Why it matters: found from random planes without prescribing any map, which shows such objects are not rare; but adding handles to its map reaches at most 54 of 66 adjacencies, so it cannot grow into a solution.

label: Lab · 10 faces, genus 2 (S6)
title: Lab · face-minimal S6 (10, 2)
note: Why it matters: a face-minimal cubic single-adjacency example under SPEC S6 and a positive control on 10 planes. Exactly checked: 24 vertices, 36 edges, 36 of 45 pairs adjacent. Found without a prescribed map; shown after polishing the planes with the map unchanged. Literature novelty is not established; this is not an all-pairs object.
